subject.title: fix(plugins): keep run context available after registration

question: Should setRunContext, getRunContext, and clearRunContext be a permanently runtime-callable plugin API after register() returns, while handles from replaced registries remain inert?
rationale: The source and tests support this interpretation, but changing the callable lifetime of a public plugin API is a compatibility boundary whose permanence requires owner intent.

options.title: Confirm the runtime contract
options.body: Approve the lifecycle semantics after the contributor adds real installed-plugin proof for set, get, and clear.

options.title: Keep registration-bound access
options.body: Reject this approach and require plugins to receive a narrower runtime-owned context handle through an explicit callback seam.

recommendation.title: Confirm the runtime contract
recommendation.body: Approve the lifecycle semantics after the contributor adds real installed-plugin proof for set, get, and clear.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this owner most directly to the session workflow API and its plugin-hook documentation.
